observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge — a demand issued without consultation or justification, performing coercive pressure through bare insistence.
Second imperative directive repeating the same coercive demand — insistence through a second bare command with no rationale offered.

mints.name: BareImperativeErasureDemand
mints.title: Forget everything… Remove all knowledge…
mints.frame: Is the speaker's power move here a bare command to erase or discard knowledge, issued without rationale, consultation, or appeal — and does that unreasoned insistence itself carry the weight?
